outcome: Maternal complications (pulmonary edema, hemorrhage, blood transfusion, length of hospital stay, anemia, hospital readmission, death)
cohort: 72 patients with preeclampsia who underwent cesarean section at a single center over an eight-month period
finding: The study found that patients with preeclampsia who underwent cesarean section had a high rate of perioperative complications, including maternal complications such as hemorrhage, blood transfusion, and prolonged hospital stay.
mod_finding: This study focuses on perioperative outcomes for patients with preeclampsia undergoing cesarean sections.
